limitation: Content hashing detects exact duplicates; it cannot certify absence of near-duplicates or pretrained data overlap.

REDS_train.note: Supplied as a local copy. Replaces Vimeo-90K (official download unavailable). No model in this study is trained on REDS, so it is unseen external test data.

reds_grouping: each REDS clip folder is one source cluster; REDS publishes no raw-video identity mapping, so near-duplicate scenes across clips cannot be excluded
reds_train_role: REDS train_sharp replaces Vimeo-90K and is used only as unseen external test data: no model in this study is trained on REDS.
